items.question: Which divine healer is asked to protect devotees while wearing white garments and a radiant crown?
premises: He is asked to protect us.
items.inference: The verse invokes Dhanvantari as protector.
uncertainties: Token contains internal sandhi and an internal space; gloss compressed to six parts.
items.plain_english: May Dhanvantari, radiant-crowned and white-garmented, giver of health, protect us.
